source_family_coverage.recipe_boundary: No demonstrated ore -> steel, wood -> charcoal or fuel-refining conversion. Deposits and upgrades must not be relabelled smelting.
Cooked whole fish appearance is directly evidenced. Prepared fillet is an explicit art proposal. T16 fish freeze is still required; recipe quantities, fuel use, timing and yields are unspecified.
Visual input/output association is evidenced; exact species and runtime conversion are not.
Equipment is depicted. No implemented generic cookhouse recipe, species eligibility or fuel requirement is established.
Rack contents are visible; drying duration, recipe IDs, state transitions and yields are unspecified.
T19 wheat freeze required. Do not invent a flour intermediate, mill recipe, baking recipe or greenhouse yield from the reference chain.
No timber dimensions, conversion rate, machine tier or implemented plank recipe is established.
Chopping acquisition and equipment are evidenced; a distinct split-firewood inventory kind or recipe is not.
HIDE and FUR are explicit atlas nouns. No complete species drop table, skinning yields, edible roster or tanning route exists in inspected sources. Companions remain separate.
A quarry drill is extraction equipment, not proof of cut blocks, bricks or finished slate tiles.

Neither the requested steel concept nor the ambiguous atlas can establishes an ore -> steel smelter or an oil/fuel refinery. The can is outside the current 20-sheet expansion; prior fuel and coal concepts do not establish conversion recipes.
Depicted equipment only; no crop list or greenhouse-specific output is established.
No supported inventory list of nails, rods, plates, gears or other workshop outputs. Do not fabricate them.
Transport, storage and service do not establish a new processed material.

global_rules: Carrier family and allowed form checked before release.
Reserve destination slot, stock and exclusive transfer owner before dispatch.
Reserve machine output before consuming inputs; a multi-input recipe reserves both ingredients together.
Wrong item remains source-held; a bounded reject area being full stops intake.
Full destination propagates wait upstream; no deletion, duplication or unbounded queue.
Storage OUT requires a request and never automatically returns to storage IN.
Food and utility cassettes serve local bays; original front aisle and right fuel hatch remain separate.
Fuel, raw-food storage, hides, cargo and cash remain manual in this upgrade.
No unlisted future recipe or production conversion is active.
